scope: Independent source identity,8-view rotation, connections and alpha inspection; no animation or Main approval.

reference.classification: Existing external-origin Inven catalog portrait. Local bytes/metadata verified; original external game pack or animation is not claimed.

visual_review.identity: White/black asymmetric carnival mask/ears with red mouth accent, white ruff, purple/gold short fitted jacket and puffed breeches, exposed red stockings/knees, dark shoes and dark/orange one-handed wand with violet orb preserve the source silhouette and palette.
visual_review.eight_views: E and W have opposite clear side profiles with predominantly right/left shoe axes. S is frontal, SE/SW front diagonals, N is fully rear with no pasted face, and NW/NE show coherent rear shoulders/coat and partial mask occlusion.
visual_review.handedness: The wand is in viewer-left hand in S and viewer-right hand in N, consistent with the same anatomical holding hand. The free hand remains on the opposite side; no guide-frame hand transfer was observed.
visual_review.connections: All8 show attached hands/wrists/wand, complete mask/head/neck and both red-clad legs/feet. The short jacket exposes the knees; there is no long skirt, cropped toe or detached violet wand tip.
visual_review.transparency: No visible broad haze/matte/halo. Beyond3px from the alpha>100 silhouette there are0 pixels withalpha>25 and maxalpha25/255; source antialiasing retained.
visual_review.inference_limit: Exact tiny mask expression/teeth/ear construction and fine costume ornaments are newly authored interpretations of a108×132 portrait. They are not verified original-game details.

next_required_validation: Single E-direction three-phase real gait with opposite anatomical support/swing legs; keep head/profile and wand hand stable. Do not expand directions or import partially until that pilot passes.
acceptance_limit: Guide8views only. No idle/walk/attack/hit/death or actual Main approval.
